en: A commemorative sports postcard featuring a color photograph of an athlete holding a pole (likely for pole vault) against a plain white background. On the right side there is a small gold Olympic-style medal graphic and red text highlighting the athlete's name and Olympic decathlon victory in Sydney. Along the left margin are vertical blue numbers separated by small running-figure icons, possibly indicating decathlon event results or scores.
